title: 瑞银胡一帆：出口仍是增长引擎，AI与绿色科技成主力
speaker: Yifan Hu

segments.en: Yeah, exports, I think, is still the main driver of the China's growth last year. 2024, 2025, contribute over 30% of GDP growth.
segments.zh: 出口仍然是去年中国增长的主要动力，2024、2025年贡献了超过30%的GDP增长。

segments.en: And this year, so far, it's 20%, but I think it will remain like between 20 to 30%. So we think the students will continue, especially in the AI and the green tech.
segments.zh: 今年到目前为止是20%，但我认为会保持在20%到30%之间。我们认为这一趋势将持续，尤其是在AI和绿色科技领域。

segments.en: This comes out about one-third of China's total exports. So we think this trend will continue.
segments.zh: 这大约占中国出口总额的三分之一。我们认为这一趋势将持续。
